name: monthly-diurnal-splines-v1
parameters: One shared six-parameter economic bid curve per local hour/technology/zone, reused across all days in the month. Actual hourly source costs and available MW remain external.
transfer: Apply the January local-hour curves directly in February, with February physical inputs; no calendar-hour averaging or February targets in inference.
solver: Clarabel0.11.1 quadratic subproblems with true nonlinear KKT certification; original Newton recovery on numerical failures. Original cubic economics and precision gates retained.
scope: Bounded January/February model-selection validation. Compare sharing and solver performance separately; no baseline promotion or annual convergence claim. Monthly sharing replaces independent calendar-hour parameters only in this candidate.
